Skunky, gassy, candy, fruity, pupil, purp and citrus funk with that lacquer sharpness to pull it all together! A cross of Runtz x PuTang. Bringing together the best of two worlds in an unlikely fashion, Mass Medical Strains is breaking barriers yet again! If the name offends you, we suggest smoking a joint of it and seeing how you feel after. It's just a name after all…

Orange pheno is one of the 3 clone-only forms of Cuntz （Runtz x PuTang） The Orange pheno has the most orange tangie profile of the 3 phenotypes. At first there’s an instant feeling of being stoned, a little confused and heavy. You then get used to it and think ok, this is alright… then the high begins to climb and climb. Extreme munchies, happiness and goofy thoughts with lots of excitement and playful joking ideas as well as some serious introspection into planet earth and our ways as humans. Music bounces around and visually patterns and objects seem to “pop” more, just like the PuTang visua…

Pink Cuntz is the most PuTang dominant clone-only phenotype of the Cuntz （Runtz x PuTang） These plants have a candy grape and citrus aroma with less influence from the Runtz but a little is detectable on the exhale making this flavor very dynamic. The high is pure focus, happiness, and energy. Productivity! At the end it mellows down to a relaxed and tranquil state. Buds are extremely pink/purple throughout. Really frosty, too. Lots of traits of the PuTang in this, but the Runtz chills it out a bit while keeping most of its uplifting qualities on an easier-to-digest, carefree focused attitude.…

The White pheno is the most Runtz dominant of the 3 clone-only phenotypes of Cuntz. （Runtz x PuTang） bred and selected by Mass Medical Strains. It has a very sharp orange citrus candy gelato fuel mixture! These terps come on strong by the third week of flower. Plant has a big vigorous stretch and serious production with unbelievable terps and white gooey resin on purple buds. The resin is so white you can barely see the color underneath! PuTang brings more euphoria and mental energy to the Runtz!
